pre_result_amendments.reason: The first launch stopped on a width assertion before any model fit or result artifact. The IMU sensor-only motion selector has 305 columns; 359 is the expanded width after adding 54 option one-hot columns.

A retry was manually stopped while fitting the second subject fold because the permutation audit redundantly re-called the independent option scorer. Exhaustive permutation evaluation is changed to exact reindexing of each fold's already computed four option scores.
The full deterministic run reached report construction, then failed because five JSON-style boolean literals were used in Python. Only those literals are corrected.

scope.reason: This is the only single-answer slice with enough rows, 18 subjects, and a direct option-semantics formulation while keeping one bounded independent branch.

parent_oof.definition: Current owned nonvisual RandomForest expert OOF. Its imported public-graph parent_prediction column is explicitly excluded.

validation.split: leave exactly one released subject ID out per fold
validation.clip_grouping: All four expanded options for a QA row and every QA row sharing its clip path stay in the same subject fold.
validation.label_access: Only the 17 training-subject labels in a fold may fit that fold's models.

environment_strata.field: first integer in the released HAU trial token <x>-<y>-<z>
environment_strata.caveat: The supplement calls the full token a trial and does not publish a ground-truth environment label, so this is reported only as a recording-condition proxy.

candidate.independence: Fit one separate option-ranking model per modality and fold; no early-fusion features or cross-modality feature sharing.

features.imu: The frozen 305 sensor-only motion columns used by the existing option-ranking expert; concatenating the 54 option one-hot columns yields 359 expanded features.
features.option: One-hot canonical option-text identity after typo normalization; sensor and option features are concatenated per option.

candidate.row_decision: When all three modalities are numerically present and at least two modality predictions agree, use their majority option. Otherwise fall back to the owned parent prediction.

counterfactual_audits.option_permutation: For every OOF row, evaluate all 24 permutations of A/B/C/D by exact reindexing of its four independently scored options; compare the selected canonical option text rather than its remapped letter.
counterfactual_audits.synonym_rewrite: Deterministically rewrite every canonical adverb as an equivalent 'in a/an <adjective> manner' phrase using a frozen morphological rule plus exceptions, then canonicalize it back before scoring.
